title: Loccy Config
description: Project config for the Loccy i18n toolchain.

include.description: Glob patterns for source files to scan

customTFunctions.description: Additional t-function names beyond the framework defaults

detectKeysInStrings.description: Try matching bare string literals against known keys. Default: true

quoteType.description: Quote style for inserted t-function calls. Omit to auto-detect from the codebase.

defaultNamespace.description: Default namespace for the t-function, when not set explicitly. Only for react-i18next.

noUnresolvedKeys.description: Lint: flag keys used in code but missing from translations. Default: true.

noUnusedKeys.description: Lint: flag unused translation keys — removed by lint --fix. Default: true. Dynamically-built keys are whitelisted via `// loccy-used-keys: pattern` comments at the construction site (not config).

glob.description: Single glob for this module's translation files.

layout.description: How file paths map to locales and namespaces.

noUntranslatedKeys.description: Lint: require every key translated & non-empty. `true` checks every detected locale; a locale list checks exactly those, for locales that are deliberately incomplete. Default: true.

sortKeys.description: Lint: deeply sort keys alphabetically. Default: false.

PartialModuleConfig.description: Raw per-module shape in the file.

excludeKeys.description: Keys to skip, formatted as `namespace:keypath` (or bare `keypath` when no namespace). Matches the exact key; use `*` glob (e.g. `prefix.*`) to match everything under a prefix. Example: `translations:landing.hero.title`

MessageFormatId.description: Plural-encoding id (message format). Closed set — only registered formats.

LayoutPattern.description:
How resource files are laid out.
- a single pattern: `{locale}.json`, `{locale}/{namespace}.json`
- per-locale patterns keyed by locale, with `*` as the fallback — for irregular conventions   (e.g. a suffix-less default file): `{ en: 'messages.properties', '*': 'messages_{locale}.properties' }`

NoUntranslatedKeysRule.description: `noUntranslatedKeys` rule: enable/disable, or the exact locales to check.

product.description: What the product is and who uses it. e.g. "Staff app for a cat café, used one-handed on a phone mid-shift."

voice.description: How the product speaks, personality, how the user is addressed. e.g. "Warm and lightly cheeky; address the user informally; no marketing filler."

mechanics.description: Constraints no locale may override: length, markup, casing of code, emoji. e.g. "Buttons and menu labels max ~25 characters. No emoji."

localeRules.description: Per-locale rules, keyed by locale code: what that language decides. e.g. "de: avoid anglicisms; German runs long, compress rather than truncate."

doNotTranslate.description: Terms preserved verbatim in every locale, such as brand and product names. e.g. "Whisker Café — never translated, casing preserved."

glossary.description: Terms with approved per-locale translations. e.g. "a booked seating slot, not the act of reserving → Reservation (en), Reservierung (de)."

keys.description: How translation keys are named and organized. e.g. "Group by feature, dot-separated: checkout.button.submit"

global.description: Split into `product`, `voice` and `mechanics`, by what each rule is about.
global.deprecationMessage: Split into `product`, `voice` and `mechanics`, by what each rule is about.

StyleguideConfig.description: Hand-authored guidance for writing and translating this project's copy.

extends.description: Locale this one inherits from, e.g. `de` for `de-CH`. Filled only where it diverges.

style.description: What changes vs the extended locale, in plain language (e.g. `ß becomes ss`). Empty/absent means full inherit.

LocaleValue.description: Per-locale style guidance: plain prose, or a partial-override object (`extends` + optional `style`).

caseSensitive.description: Respect casing when matching this term.

definition.description: Optional definition (why it's preserved, a spelling detail, etc).

DoNotTranslateEntry.description: A term whose literal form must be preserved across all locales.

definition.description: What the term means and when it applies.

GlossaryEntry.description: A term with approved per-locale translations, for terminology consistency.

preferred.description: The approved form for this locale.

deprecated.description: Forms that must never appear for this locale — always flagged.

GlossaryLocaleValue.description: Approved term for one locale: a string, or `{ preferred, deprecated? }` to also flag old forms.
